# ST Tracker — Gujarat ST (GSRTC) Live Bus Tracker
> ST Tracker (https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in & https://tracker.shivrajsinh.in) is a free, real-time GPS tracking and timetable utility for Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC) buses and commuters across Gujarat, India.

## Overview
- **Portal URL**: https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in
- **Web App**: https://tracker.shivrajsinh.in
- **Author & Developer**: Shivrajsinh Zala (https://shivrajsinh.in)
- **Fleet & Network Scope**: 8,554+ buses, 19,026+ bus stations and rural stops, 16 administrative divisions, 126+ depots across Gujarat.
- **Commuter Volume**: Serving over 2.5 million daily passengers and operating 2.8+ million kilometers daily.
- **Pricing & Access**: 100% Free public service utility. Zero subscription fees, zero account requirement, no app store download necessary.
- **Languages**: English and Gujarati (ગુજરાતી at https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gu).
- **Full Context Specification**: https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/llms-full.txt

## Key Capabilities & Technical Telematics
- **Live GPS Tracking by Plate**: Enter any Gujarat ST bus plate (e.g., `GJ-18-ZT-1028`) to track vehicle coordinates on a live map, instantaneous speed (km/h), next stop ETA, and distance from user.
- **AIS-140 Compliant Telematics**: Uses on-board Vehicle Location Tracking (VLT) devices mandated under Indian AIS-140 standards, refreshed every ~20 seconds with 10–25m roadside accuracy.
- **Timetable & Countdown Engine**: Search between any two of Gujarat's 19,026 stations. Active trips show live countdowns (`🟢 On Time`, `🟡 Late`); upcoming trips display scheduled departure times.
- **Online Booking / PNR Tracking**: Direct lookup and tracking for tickets booked through GSRTC, redBus, or AbhiBus using ticket PNR.
- **Nearby Bus Stands Radar**: Uses device geolocation to identify nearest ST depots and bus stands sorted by proximity.
- **Community Crowd Reporting**: Real-time crowd reports for seat availability, standing room, or trip cancellations.
- **Arrival Alerts**: Background arrival notifications before a bus reaches your boarding stop.

## Core Route Corridors & Schedules
- [Ahmedabad to Vadodara ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-vadodara-bus): 110 km corridor via National Expressway 1 (NE1). Frequency every 15–20 mins.
- [Ahmedabad to Rajkot ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-rajkot-bus): 215 km Saurashtra gateway via NH47. Express and Gurjarnagri departures.
- [Vadodara to Surat ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/vadodara-surat-bus): 140 km South Gujarat corridor via NH48.
- [Ahmedabad to Surat ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-surat-bus): 265 km major intercity route. AC Sleeper, Volvo, and Gurjarnagri.
- [Rajkot to Morbi ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/rajkot-morbi-bus): 65 km high-density ceramic industrial corridor. Departures every 10–15 mins.
- [Ahmedabad to Gandhinagar ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-gandhinagar-bus): 30 km capital shuttle with frequent electric e-buses.
- [Ahmedabad to Somnath ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-somnath-bus): 410 km Saurashtra coastal pilgrimage route.
- [Ahmedabad to Dwarka ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-dwarka-bus): 440 km pilgrimage corridor with overnight AC/Non-AC Sleeper buses.
- [Somnath to Dwarka ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/somnath-dwarka-bus): 230 km coastal pilgrimage circuit connecting Somnath Jyotirlinga and Dwarka.
- [Surat to Rajkot ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/surat-rajkot-bus): 420 km diamond-ceramic intercity connection.

## Guides & Commuter Documentation
- [How GSRTC Live Tracking Works](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-live-bus-tracking): Telematics, AIS-140 GPS data pipeline, and trip lifecycle.
- [GSRTC Bus Number Plate Format](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-bus-number-plate-format): Structure of Gujarat RTO prefixes (GJ-01 to GJ-38) and registration logic.
- [GSRTC Bus Fleet Scale](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-bus-fleet): Fleet breakdown (8,554 buses), division network, and depot allocation.
- [GSRTC Bus Stand Helplines](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-bus-stand-helpline-numbers): Central 24x7 helpline (1800 233 6666) and division depot control room contacts.
- [GSRTC Online Booking & PNR Tracking](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-online-booking-pnr-tracking): Guide to tracking buses via PNR.
- [GSRTC Bus Timetable Guide](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-bus-timetable): How to query 19,026 stations and filter departures.
- [GSRTC Bus Pass Online (ESCPS)](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-bus-pass-online): Student and commuter monthly pass application process.
- [GSRTC Cancellation & Refund Rules](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-ticket-cancellation-refund): Official deduction slabs (10%, 20%, 50%, 100%) and refund timeline.
- [GSRTC Luggage Rules & Charges](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-luggage-rules-rates): Free baggage limits (25kg to 35kg) and excess tariff slabs.
- [GSRTC Bus Types & Fleet Classes](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-bus-types-classes): Local, Express, Gurjarnagri 2x2, Sleeper, and Volvo Scania comparisons.
